title:
Epic that initializes the {@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#sensors} and
{@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#existingMutedPeriods} fields.

The {@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#sensors} field is populated using the
{@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#selectedSensorsIds}, which are set when the user selects
{@link Sensor}s in the grid.

The {@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#existingMutedPeriods} field is populated by fetching
the active {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s associated with the selected {@link Sensor}s.
name: InitializeSensorAlertMutedPeriodApplicationStateEpic
